title: Toolbar: a bar along the bottom of every model scene listing the active tool's keys
user-messages:
> Does the toolbar belong to this ticket or its own change?

own change new ticket
description:
A bar along the bottom of the window that lists the active tool's keys. Split out of the stroke-segmentation worktree (CRAW-105), where it was built without a ticket.

## What exists

`Scene` draws the toolbar when `showToolbar` is set, `ModelScene` sets it, and `MultiviewScreenshot` hides it in multiview cells and puts it back afterwards.

## What the review found

From ai-workspace `reports/craw-105-uncommitted-review-2026-11-12.md` (part 5): the toolbar is on in all nine model scenes, so every model scene's screenshots change, not only the ring scene's. No test covers it.

## Related

UI-20 (key and mouse glyphs in the toolbar instead of text) builds on this.
definition-of-done: 1. The toolbar shows the active tool's keys in every model scene and is hidden in multiview screenshot cells. 2. A test covers which keys it lists. 3. A launch.json entry and a screenshot under tmp/ show it.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: the toolbar lists the active tool's control rows and changes when the tool is switched. 2. Unit test: a multiview screenshot has no toolbar in its cells and the toolbar is back afterwards. 3. Screenshot the ring scene and one other model scene with the toolbar showing.
